designArgument.spine: The Citizen lens is not an empty lens. It is a lens with NOWHERE TO PUT A SOURCE, and those are different sentences to a reader. Every other undesigned or unfed lens in this set — Police's vendored regions, Public works' capital projects, Fleet — has a registered domain that a grant would fill. citizen has 0 of 11. So the design problem is not 'draw the empty state' but 'keep four different distances from data apart on a page that has no measurements at all'.

theFourDistances.no-region: there is nowhere to attach a source: the surface is not in the registry. No grant changes this; registering the domain does.
theFourDistances.no-capability: the product does not do this on any city. payments is false on every lead lens, so a city-scoped sentence here would be false.
theFourDistances.no-source: the product does this and this city has not connected it. The only distance that varies by city, and the only one a grant closes.
theFourDistances.no-identity: no grant can measure it, on any city, ever. The lens is public-free and holds no account, so a per-resident count has no subject.

designArgument.theStructuralRule: A region prints a state word, a distance and a basis — or it prints none of the three. A state word with no basis is a claim; a distance with no basis is a label.
designArgument.theOneWordChanged: 'None on file' → 'Not read'. Two mechanical objections, neither stylistic. (1) The word is outside the product's own five-word vocabulary, in the one place a reader looks for a region's state. (2) It is a zero about a subject the lens has never established: it says this resident has no requests, on a surface that by design does not know who is reading. That is the exact collapse the acceptance clause forbids.
boardPlan: Main.dc.html — the un-fed lens. Four regions, four DISTINCT distances (no-region / no-identity / no-capability / no-source), four bases, and the one word changed. Every region figure is unmeasured; the only measurements are product-scoped facts (registry census 0 of 11, route literals 0, regions on the shipped surface 4, regions with a shipped basis 1), each carrying its counting rule.

Distances.dc.html — five cards: the four distances plus the measured zero, each with its basis, its instrument, and what would change it. This is the board that makes 'a zero is a measurement, Not read is the absence of one' legible in one screen.

Filled.dc.html — the contract board, DEMO FIXTURE badged in three places (top bar, footer, every row). A measured 1 and a measured 0 beside two regions NO fixture can fill, because the product has no identity and no payment processor on any city.
designArgument.boardsCutAndWhy: No board for a connected Citizen lens. Drawing what the page looks like once a source lands would be drawing a product decision nobody has made, and it is how a 'not built' page quietly becomes a roadmap promise. The contract board draws the CONTRACT instead, which is the part that is knowable today.
designArgument.whyTheFixtureBoardExists: The acceptance clause is a two-sided rule and a single board cannot carry both sides. Main must carry ZERO region-scoped measurements (any region figure there would be invented); the fixture board must carry at least one region-scoped measurement, including at least one measured ZERO and at least one region still unread. A design that only ever showed the un-fed state could never demonstrate that zero and Not read are drawn differently.

instrumentPlan.selfTestsBothDirections: every predicate proved able to accept AND to refuse before any artboard is read; a failure aborts with exit 2 rather than reporting a verdict. 54 tests, on synthetic markup built from the same shapes the boards use.
instrumentPlan.matchedInputCounts: 14 counts reported (bodies, regions, distances, bases, badges, mechanismChips, cells, figures, measuredFigures, unmeasuredFigures, measuredZeros, fixtureRows, controls, verbatimSentences); any one reaching zero refuses the verdict with exit 2.
instrumentPlan.scopeIsStructural: every read except two is scoped to the content inside `<main data-lens-body="citizen">`, so the nav's own shipped badges neither satisfy nor violate a rule about the Citizen page. Removing the marker makes the check ABORT for that board, never fall back to the whole document. The two document-wide reads are the Citizen nav badge tie (chrome, a shipped value) and the DEMO FIXTURE marker (a badge, which belongs in chrome) — both named as such in the file.
instrumentPlan.vacuityIsItsOwnRule: a predicate with no inputs is filed as R13, not under the rule it would have disabled. 'This board gave that rule no input' and 'this board broke that rule' are different statements.
instrumentPlan.commitTie: canvas.json and source-state.json must name the same product commit or the instrument refuses. Two independent files, one commit.
instrumentPlan.premiseGuards: the instrument refuses on 14 moved product facts, not just one: a registered citizen domain, a composer route naming it, a changed accessPolicy, a skuName appearing, payments flipping true, citizen becoming a staff department, 'None on file' entering the vocabulary, and the pinned string sets not coming through source-state.json at all.
instrumentPlan.verifiedByViolation: 16 plants into throwaway copies of the folder, one at a time, each caught by the rule that exists for it, including both refusal paths (a moved premise and a predicate with no inputs). The plants run on COPIES, so the real artboards are never mutated and no restore step is needed — stronger than plant-then-restore, and the reason no artboard md5 changes in this lane.

findingsToCarry: THE SHIPPED PAGE PRINTS A WORD THE PRODUCT DOES NOT DEFINE. 'Your requests' carries the quiet pill 'None on file' and the badge vocabulary declared in src/ui.test.mjs is Empty / Not built / Not read / Preview / Not connected. This is a one-word product defect on the only surface a resident sees, and it is the design's whole exhibit: check.mjs proves its vocabulary rule can fire by finding this pill outside the set on the SHIPPED side rather than on the design's.

THE PRODUCT HAS NO STATE WORD FOR A REGION WITH NOTHING TO MEASURE BY DESIGN. Four values in DOMAIN_STATUSES plus the fifth not-registered state all describe SOURCES. 'Not read' is the closest shipped word and it is about a reading, not about a subject that cannot exist. The design uses 'Not read' rather than inventing a sixth word, and the basis carries the distinction — but the gap is real and it is the same gap Parks found from the other side.

THE CITIZEN LENS IS THE FURTHEST THING FROM A DATA SURFACE IN THE SET AND THE NAV GIVES IT THE SAME 'Preview' BADGE AS EVERY OTHER UNBUILT LENS. Preview means 'not a real city yet' for a lens whose real obstacle is that it has no registered domain at all. The design keeps the shipped badge (check.mjs refuses a board that disagrees with it) and puts the difference in the body, but a reader scanning the nav cannot tell this lens from one whose grant is late.

THE TWELVE-TILE GRID IS DROPPED BUT THE SHIPPED HOME ROW STILL SAYS 'Mounted'. src/shell-homes.mjs records the disposition as Mounted for a job whose home sentence says the grid was dropped. Same class as the stale lens-granular dispositions Police reported; named, not re-opened.

NO CITIZEN DOMAIN EXISTS TO REGISTER, SO NO FIXTURE PACK CAN PROVE THIS SURFACE. A fixture can supply addresses and meetings; it cannot supply an identity or a payment processor, and it cannot supply a registry entry. That is why the fixture board draws a CONTRACT and leaves two of four regions unfilled, rather than drawing a filled page.

bastrop_tx GRANTS SEVEN LIVE FEEDS AND NONE OF THEM IS A CITIZEN-FACING SOURCE. Whether Bastrop has a citizen-facing address lookup at all is UNESTABLISHED from this repository — the registry carries no citizen domain, so nothing here answers it either way. Stated as unestablished rather than assumed.

The design shows the honest word and the instrument refuses the shipped one on a design board; changing web/index.html is a product change with a test assertion behind it and belongs to whoever owns the Citizen lens implementation row.

A SIXTH STATE WORD FOR 'NOTHING TO MEASURE BY DESIGN'. Four distances are drawn with four distinct mechanism chips and no invented badge word. Whether the product wants a word of its own for the no-identity case is a vocabulary decision for the atom contract, not a board decision.
THE NAV BADGE FOR A LENS WITH NO REGISTERED DOMAIN. Raised above; not settled here.
